description: Cases for the PWA progress statistics (lib/repositories/stats.ts run on a seeded Dexie database, lib/insights.ts, lib/gym-filter.ts, lib/coach-snapshot.ts) and their Android port (core:domain stats/WorkoutStats.kt, stats/Insights.kt). Datasets list every row, tombstones included ('deletedAt' non-null); 'expected' is what the PWA functions return evaluated with the process time zone 'zone' and clock 'now' (epoch ms). Warm-up sets (esCalentamiento) count in EVERY metric, as in the PWA. byGym[].gymId null = all gyms. Volumes are float sums: compare with a small tolerance.
deloadAdvice: Prueba bajar ~10% y vuelve a subir, o cambia de ejercicio.
